items.h: Jeudy brought in three of nine targets for 48 yards in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
items.s: Joe Flacco completed under 50.0 percent of his passes on the afternoon, so Jeudy's inefficiency isn't surprising. The veteran wideout did finished second in receiving yards while pacing the Browns in targets, and Jeudy has either eight or nine targets in three of four contests this year. The 2020 first-round pick doesn't lack for upside, but Flacco's struggles -- and the fact that he would be replaced by a rookie if he were to get benched -- depress Jeudy's fantasy outlook.
